description: Repository knowledge refresh. Node 22+, workspace-local state. Review these hooks in your client.

hooks.command: node -e "const f=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');let r=process.cwd();while(!f.existsSync(p.join(r,'.agents/hooks/repo-knowledge.mjs'))){const n=p.dirname(r);if(n===r)throw Error('Repository hook not found');r=n;}import(require('node:url').pathToFileURL(p.join(r,'.agents/hooks/repo-knowledge.mjs')).href)" codex
